description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (NotesAdapter) for displaying a list of notes in an Android application. It manages the creation and binding of view holders, handles click events on individual notes, and enables efficient list updates using DiffUtil.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Note objects, supporting click events and efficient list updates.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual note items, responsible for binding note data to the view.

classes.name: NoteDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback for calculating differences between old and new note lists for efficient updates.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NoteViewHolder instance by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a note item to a given ViewHolder based on its position in the list.

methods.name: NoteViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the UI components of the ViewHolder.

methods.name: NoteDiffCallback.areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two notes represent the same item by comparing their IDs.

methods.name: NoteDiffCallback.areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two notes are identical.
